kept.excerpt: Russian forces recently conducted an infiltration mission south of Dobropillya. Ukrainian forces struck a Russian position west of Hryshyne (south of Dobropillya) after what ISW assesses was a Russian infiltration mission based on geolocated footage published on September 17.
kept.publisher: Institute for the Study of War
kept.relevance: This cutoff-date observation locates Russian activity immediately west of Hryshyne, but does not establish Ukrainian capture inside the settlement or qualifying map shading.

kept.excerpt: A Ukrainian counteroffensive made gains north of Lyman, but Russian forces retained the offensive initiative across the battlespace. These efforts underscore the intensity of the battlespace: last week Ukraine and Russia waged more than 250 tactical engagements per day. Pokrovsk, Kostiantynivka, and Huliaipole remained the most important flashpoints to monitor.
kept.relevance: This expert assessment provides context on Ukraine's demonstrated counteroffensive capacity while identifying continuing Russian offensive pressure around Pokrovsk.

kept.excerpt: Ukrainian forces recently advanced or maintained positions southwest of Dobropillya. Ukrainian forces hold positions northeast of Novopidhorodne, according to geolocated footage published on September 13, contrary to Russian claims. Russian forces are heavily relying on drone and glide bomb strikes in the Dobropillya area, likely due to localized Russian personnel shortages following tactical failures to advance in the killzone.
kept.publisher: Institute for the Study of War
kept.relevance: This assessment documents Ukrainian positions and Russian tactical constraints in the broader sector without treating nearby activity as evidence of re-entry into Hryshyne.

kept.excerpt: Over the past day, September 12, there were 249 combat engagements between units of the Defense Forces of Ukraine and Russian troops along the front line. According to Ukrinform, this was reported by the General Staff of the Armed Forces of Ukraine in a Facebook post on the situation as of 8:00 on Sunday, September 13. The enemy was active near Shakhove, Molodetske, Bilytske, Serhiivka and Udachne, and also launched assaults toward Toretske, Kucheriv Yar, Stepove, Dorozhnie, Svitle, Shevchenko, Matiasheve, Novohryshyne, Hryshyne, and Novopidhorodne.
kept.publisher: Ukrinform, reporting the Ukrainian General Staff
kept.relevance: The official military update places Hryshyne among active Russian assault directions shortly before the cutoff, although it does not specify control within municipal boundaries.

kept.excerpt: Based on data from Ukraine’s DeepState OSINT group, Russian forces made a net gain of 14 square miles of Ukraine’s territory in the past four weeks (Aug. 11–Sept. 8, 2026). In contrast, RM’s analysis of data from ISW indicates that Russia made a net gain of 75 square miles of Ukraine’s territory in the past four weeks (Aug. 11–Sept. 8, 2026). Settlements near which Russian forces advanced Sept. 1–8, 2026, according to DeepState: Bochkove, Ivashkyne, Luhivske, Hulyaypilske, Holubivka, Stupochky, Kostiantynivka, Shevchenko, Mali Shcherbaky, Varvarivka, Hryshyne, Kalenyky, Fedorivka Druha, Stepanivka, and Kotlyne.
kept.relevance: This dated territorial comparison identifies recent Russian advances near Hryshyne and shows material differences between mapping methodologies relevant to an ISW-specific resolution.

kept.excerpt: Assessed Russian advances: Geolocated footage published on March 9 and 10 indicates that Russian forces recently advanced east of and in western and central Hryshyne.
kept.publisher: Institute for the Study of War
kept.relevance: This historical ISW assessment establishes earlier Russian advances inside Hryshyne as background for the re-entry question, without establishing the settlement's exact control on the experiment date.

search_notes: Frozen evidence cutoff: 2026-09-17, inclusive; all retained items have explicit publication dates on or before that date. Excerpts reproduce source text exposed by web_search, with citation markers omitted. Direct web_fetch failed because of provider configuration; the agent-reach skill web-reader fallback returned RATE_LIMITED and was not retried. Full-page and archived-version verification therefore remain incomplete. Later-dated results, prediction-market and betting material, prices, odds, and outcome information were excluded from the pack. No frozen ISW map snapshot was verified for the intersection of Hryshyne's Ukrainian Settlements boundary and the Claimed Ukrainian Counteroffensives layer, and persistence through a subsequent full daily update was not verified. Nearby strikes, infiltration, assaults, and advances elsewhere do not establish that resolution condition. Market creation time was not supplied, and the negotiated-settlement clause in the supplied rules is truncated. No outcome or probability estimate is included.
